title: Path Smoother Spline
text: Smooth vehicle path using cubic spline interpolation, 2 inputs, 4 outputs; {Number of output poses} sets the number of smooth poses to return, {Minimum separation of input poses} sets the minimum separation between, {Sample time}, {Show CumLengths and Curvatures output ports} sets the output cumulative path lengths and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: RefPoses
ports.summary: Reference poses M -by-3 matrix of [ x, y, Θ ] vectors

ports.name: RefDirections
ports.summary: Reference directions M -by-1 column vector of 1s (forward motion) and –1s (reverse motion)

ports.name: Poses
ports.summary: Discretized poses of smoothed path N -by-3 matrix of [ x, y, Θ ] vectors

ports.name: Directions
ports.summary: Driving directions at each output pose N -by-1 column vector of 1s (forward motion) and –1s (reverse motion)

ports.name: CumLengths
ports.summary: Cumulative path lengths N -by-1 real-valued column vector

ports.name: Curvatures
ports.summary: Signed path curvatures N -by-1 real-valued column vector

params.name: Number of output poses
params.values: Number of smooth poses to return 100 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Minimum separation of input poses
params.values: Minimum separation between poses 1e-3 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Show CumLengths and Curvatures output ports
params.values: Output cumulative path lengths and curvatures off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code Generation (default) | Interpreted Execution
